tools.name: pypi_package
tools.description:
PyPI metadata for a package: latest version, license, requires_python, first and latest
        upload dates, number of non-yanked releases, and runtime dependencies (extras excluded).

tools.name: pypi_releases
tools.description:
Release history of a PyPI package, newest first. Includes total_releases and
        releases_per_year (non-yanked releases, pre-releases included, dated by first upload).
        Pass year to list only that calendar year.

tools.name: pypi_version
tools.description: Metadata for one specific version of a PyPI package: requires_python, dependencies, upload date.

tools.name: github_repo
tools.description: GitHub repository metadata: description, primary language, license, created/pushed dates, stars.

tools.name: github_languages
tools.description: Bytes and percent of code per language in a GitHub repository.

tools.name: github_list_dir
tools.description: List files and folders at a path in a GitHub repository (default branch). Empty path = root.

tools.name: github_read_file
tools.description: Read a text file from a GitHub repository (default branch), truncated to max_chars.

tools.name: github_workflow_runs
tools.description: Recent GitHub Actions runs (newest first) with workflow name, event, conclusion and branch.

tools.name: github_commits
tools.description: Recent commits on the default branch (newest first): short sha, date, first line of message.

tools.name: github_create_pull_request
tools.description:
Open a DRAFT pull request that writes the given files on a new branch. Requires a human
        approval bound to this exact payload; without one it returns the approval command to run.
